Your brain relies on a network of signaling molecules that help regulate motivation, mood, connection, calm, focus, and sleep. Small daily behaviors can help create the conditions these systems respond to.

☀️ Morning light
🏃 Movement
🤝 Social connection
🧘 Slow breathing or quiet time
🌙 Dimmer light in the evening

None of these are quick fixes. But practiced regularly, they can help support the biological systems that shape how you feel, focus, and rest throughout the day.

Why wouldn't you want your testosterone as high as possible? drbenhouse has a good answer.

High levels of testosterone, outside that of endogenous production, upregulates EPO, which tells your body to make more red blood cells. More red blood cells means thicker blood. You're not pumping blood anymore, you're pumping oil.

Now add left ventricular hypertrophy. The heart wall thickens, and causes a host of other problems. 

As Ben puts it, when you're at extremely high levels of testosterone, your heart is pumping ketchup, and the back pressure from all of the muscle doesn't help.
